summary: From 20 base records, six distinct operating sponsors qualify for Tampa Multifamily single-asset closings between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31 in the $17.5M–$52.5M range with a current CFO/Head of Acquisitions verified on or after 2026-03-01: Dogwood Grove 6 Capital ($38.5M, 2026-07-10), Dogwood Square 5 Capital ($36.4M, 2026-06-09), Dogwood Square 4 Capital ($34.3M, 2026-05-08), Dogwood Point 3 Capital ($32.2M, 2026-04-07), Dogwood Crossing 2 Capital ($30.1M, 2026-03-06), and Dogwood Park 1 Capital ($28.0M, 2026-02-05). Key adjudications: U-R9429-1 (current team page, effective 2026-08-20) replaces the R9429 contact with Drew Dogwood, CFO; U-R3432-3 is an unsigned draft and does not raise the R3432 size out of range; U-R1761-2 is dated 2026-09-10, after the cutoff, so R1761's CFO remains current for this as-of date. Entity DOGWOOD-SPO-18376 occupies one slot only, with R1101 (second source) and R6695 (SPV under executed ownership schedule) deduplicated to it. Fourteen records were excluded for market, asset class, activity type (announced bid), size basis (portfolio total), size, date window, post-cutoff publication, stale or non-qualifying contacts (former employee, registered agent, 2024 verification), or excluded firm kinds (broker, property manager). One selected sponsor (Dogwood Square 5 Capital) has no published business email, reported as an explicit null.
limitations: Shortlist contains six sponsors, fewer than the ten requested, because the remaining records fail at least one hard eligibility rule; no additional evidence was available within scope.
contact_email for Dogwood Square 5 Capital (R9831) is null (email_basis: not_published); it was not inferred or guessed.

For parent DOGWOOD-SPO-18376 the slot is reported using the parent's own record R1890 ($28,000,000, 2026-02-05). The SPV record R6695 evidences a separate, larger and later closing ($40,600,000, 2026-02-11) attributable to the same parent; if the intent were to represent the parent by its most recent/largest qualifying deal, that entry's rank and figures would change. No evidence links R6695's contact (Jordan Dogwood7, CFO) to the parent entity, so parent-level facts were kept from S-R1890/S-R1101.
R1761 is included because U-R1761-2 postdates the 2026-08-31 cutoff; that contact is evidenced as former as of 2026-09-10, so the lead is likely stale for outreach after the cutoff.
R4246 (Dogwood Grove 18, $34.3M, 2026-07-22) would otherwise satisfy every rule but its only source was published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff; it may qualify on a later as-of date.
R3432's size rests solely on the base extract; if U-R3432-3 were later executed at $140,000,000 the deal would exceed the size ceiling and drop out.
Contact verification relies on the supplied contact_verified_at and team-page dates; no independent role or title confirmation was possible within scope.
Records with missing fields were treated as unknown rather than zero; no external search, CRM, or contact enrichment was used, and no messages or CRM records were created.

Artifact generation (prospect CSV / comp-grid XLSX) is outside this direct API control, so no file was produced or delivered; all selected facts, citations, explicit nulls and USD units are presented in this JSON for downstream export.
